responsibility: Serves as the crate root for `rustc_const_eval` by assembling the main const-checking, const-evaluation, interpreter, utility, and error modules, exposing shared error-reporting traits, loading the crate’s Fluent diagnostic messages, and registering this crate’s query providers and hooks that implement constant evaluation, static initialization, valtree conversion, caller-location support, and validity checking for the compiler. It also owns the global shutdown flag read by the interpreter during evaluation.
